name: Spec & Contract Check Before Code
description: Enforces spec-before-code: verifies requirements/spec and API contract exist before allowing implementation code to be written.

then.prompt:
Check .compliance-state.json → currentPhase. This hook applies from Foundation phase onward. If Setup phase, skip silently.

Before writing implementation code, verify. Each numbered check names the rule ID it enforces; log that ID in the event below:

1. REQUIREMENTS [GOV-SESSION-001]: Check if a requirements/spec document exists for the current feature (look in .kiro/specs/ or project docs).
2. API CONTRACT [GOV-API-001]: If writing controller/endpoint code, check if an API contract (OpenAPI spec) exists for this module.
3. DOMAIN MODEL [GOV-SESSION-003]: If writing application/infrastructure layer code, check if the domain layer exists first.
4. LAYER ORDER [PG-INCEP-001]: Verify correct layer order: domain → application → infrastructure → presentation → tests.

If any are missing, issue a WARNING explaining what should exist first. Reference: design precedes implementation, contracts precede controllers.

Do NOT block the operation. Warn only.
If all checks pass, confirm compliance silently.

## Compliance Logging
After completing all checks above, append a JSON event to `compliance-log/events/{today-date}.jsonl` (create the file if it doesn't exist) — ONE event per rule checked, and `ruleId` MUST be the actual rule ID from the check above, NEVER a literal placeholder. Format:
{"timestamp": "{ISO-8601-UTC}", "type": "check", "id": "chk-{date}-{time}-{seq}", "hook": "pre-code-spec-check", "trigger": "preToolUse", "ruleId": "{the ID from the checked rule, e.g. GOV-SESSION-001}", "ruleSeverity": "{severity}", "result": "{pass|fail|warn}", "message": "{one-line-finding}"}
Log ONE event per rule checked.
